uiIssues.issue: On a capped session your ticket does not cover, the screen still offers a full-width blue Join Waitlist button, and tapping it does nothing except print a red line saying the session is for other ticket types, which disappears again the moment you leave the screen or reload.
uiIssues.fix: Decide eligibility before the button is drawn: show the ticket line under the title on arrival and render the button disabled or absent instead of letting a tap be the only way to find out.

uiIssues.issue: Headings inside an organizer page render at exactly the same size, weight and colour as the paragraphs, so the FAQ and the Wi-Fi page read as one undifferentiated run of sentences with no way to scan for the question you want.
uiIssues.fix: Stop wrapping a plain inline run in a nested Text, which resets the heading's 20px/600 back to body 17px/400; return the string itself.

uiIssues.issue: Replies on a topic carry no name, no avatar and no time, so three people answering a question all look like the same anonymous voice, and only your own reply is labelled, with the word You.
uiIssues.fix: Put the author's name and a relative time on every reply, resolved the same way the People list resolves a name.

uiIssues.issue: The bookmark star on every attendee row is a 20pt square, the smallest control in the app and repeated 44 times down the list, and the Say Hi button beside it measures 64 by 28 in a phone browser.
uiIssues.fix: Pair both hitSlop calls with webSlop, as the rest of the app does, and raise the star's slop so it reaches 44pt on the phone too.

uiIssues.issue: After voting in a session poll every option gains a dash on its right where a percentage would sit, four of them in a column, and the sentence underneath already says results are not available.
uiIssues.fix: When the poll will never be counted, drop the per-row dash and let the one sentence carry it.

uiIssues.issue: A divider is drawn under the last row of these lists, so a hairline hangs below the final announcement in the grey area with nothing after it.
uiIssues.fix: Skip the rule on the last item, the way the session and Q&A lists already do with their last prop.

uiIssues.issue: The empty Job title box shows Principal Ontologist as its placeholder, a plausible real job title, so the field reads as already filled in while Company and About show instructions instead.
uiIssues.fix: Use a prompt rather than a specimen, matching Where you work and What you work on.

uiIssues.issue: Each sponsor row repeats its tier under the name while a grey tier header sits directly above the group, so Platinum is printed three times in the first six centimetres of the list.
uiIssues.fix: Drop the tier from the row and leave the booth number, since the section header already says it.

uiIssues.issue: Session Q&A opens a single flat list of 71 sessions running to about seven and a half screens, with no day headers and nothing to jump with, although the agenda beside it groups the same sessions by day.
uiIssues.fix: Group the rows by day with sticky day headers, or default to today.

uiIssues.issue: Test data is on the phone: the top announcement is titled Room 271 has moved to Classroom 4 (19:17:05), two handouts are hosted at example.invalid, and the badge says you checked in on Sunday for an event that runs Monday to Friday.
uiIssues.fix: Clean these rows out of the seeded event; this is data, not code.
